newsitem.title: POLAND: Warsaw bourse seen stabilising ahead of 16,000.
newsitem.headline: Warsaw bourse seen stabilising ahead of 16,000.

text.p: The Warsaw bourse was expected to stay flat on Tuesday following Monday's mixed continuous trade, analysts said.
They said the market should slow its falls or even slightly rebound as it was approaching a strong psychological support of 16,000, a level where bourse prices start to look attractive.
Some said Monday's rise on Wall Street might additionally spur domestic demand.
